preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines: the first line contains the integer N, and the second line contains the string S.
The integer N on the first line equals the length of the string S on the second line.
The length of the string S is between 2 and 500 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i + 2, len(S) + 1) if S[i:j] == S[i:j][::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all substrings of S with length at least 2 that are palindromes.
